findings.what_happened: In Turn 1 reasoning, the assistant asserted that 'The Practice of Love' was directed by Norwegian filmmaker Maria Sødahl. This information is not present in any of the provided Hop 1 passages [1]–[7], failing the requirement to base evidence and deductions on the provided context.
findings.quote: Searching for the director of "The Practice of Love" (Kjærlighetens kjøtere/The Practice of Love, 2000), it was directed by the Norwegian filmmaker Maria Sødahl.
